decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component sprayer extends the firm's core corrosion-protection offer and has stayed listed on the website since 2023, so there is no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
The low-pressure injection pump has its own page and a documented field application on a construction site, which shows results that meet aspirations in the construction repair segment.
The low-pressure transfer pump reuses proven air motors, so it adds little cost to the established portfolio and is easily carried by the firm's slack in a growing industry.
Fire protection flow monitoring is presented on its own page and supports the firm's digitalization and interoperability goals, so dropping it is unlikely.

The hydraulic two-component system launched only in 2024 and sits close to the core offer, so with uncertain early results and available slack the firm would keep it rather than search for other uses of the resources.
